procedures.name: read_only_file_browse
riskPoints: Deleting, sharing, moving, uploading, or installing files requires confirm_user before commit.

steps.intent: Open the Files app and inspect the current root or recent files screen.
steps.expectedObservation: A Files toolbar, Recent title, folder list, or file list is visible.
steps.fallbackStrategy: If a permission dialog appears, stop at confirm_user before granting permission.
